C0191.title: Supreme People's Procuratorate Disclosed Luoyang's 150-Million-Yuan Click-Farming Platform False Advertising Case
C0191.summary: In July 2025, the Supreme People's Procuratorate disclosed a hundred-million-yuan click-farming platform false-advertising case handled by the Luoyang High-tech Zone People's Procuratorate. Under the headline 'digging into a small case uncovered a hundred-million-yuan click-farming network,' the report described how prosecutors traced small-case clues to platforms organizing fake transactions, fake reviews, and rebate loops, showing how click farming damages e-commerce transaction reviews and advertising truthfulness. The case also suggests that platforms should correlate order, review, rebate, and merchant-advertising data to identify click-farming networks, and watch abnormal links among worker recruitment, task dispatch, merchant settlement, and review posting so task-based click-farming supply can be blocked early, reducing the risk that merchants and consumers are misled.
